chapters.title: Typed shop tools
chapters.question: A draft is a calculation, not a purchase
chapters.construct: Construct the complete tool factory: reject duplicate product identities, isolate a copied stock snapshot, expose stock and supplier tools, and make draft quantity equal current need. Preserve strict Pydantic argument validation and GBP integer-pence arithmetic.
chapters.connect: Compare schema refusal, business-rule refusal and successful calculation. Connect build_tools to the same Dispatcher used by the Chapter 3 loop.
chapters.diagnosis: An integer quantity can be schema-valid and still over-order.
chapters.hint: Use rows keyed by identity, closures over a deep copy, the existing argument models, and three ExecutableTool registrations.
chapters.transfer: Try a changed stock snapshot, an empty catalog, duplicated identities and a True quantity. Record which boundary refuses each.
chapters.limit: No supplier send exists in these tools.

chapters.title: Durable memory
chapters.question: A correction must change the next model context
chapters.construct: Build bounded retrieval from assistant_preferences. Select only this session and active revisions, rank case-insensitive word overlap, break ties by newest identity, and preserve provenance.
chapters.connect: Remember, correct, close and reopen SQLite; invoke context and inspect the actual system message seen by the model.
chapters.diagnosis: Putting the new preference first does not remove contradictory old guidance.
chapters.hint: Use a parameterized query, set intersection for relevance, deterministic ties and a validated maximum.
chapters.transfer: Correct twice, forget one key and introduce another session with the same preference name. Prove no stale or foreign value reaches context.
chapters.limit: Forgetting future context is not secure erasure of backups or past provider requests.

chapters.title: Versioned skills
chapters.question: Guidance cannot create capability
chapters.construct: Construct context assembly from active eligible skills, explicit preferences and revision-matching completed history. Enforce the byte budget and retain provenance before adding the current user request.
chapters.connect: Stage and activate a local skill through the existing API, then inspect context with and without its required tool capability.
chapters.diagnosis: An active procedure may require a tool the current worker cannot call.
chapters.hint: Read active rows; require the full requires set; append preferences and bounded matching history; admit items only within the JSON byte budget.
chapters.transfer: Compare staged-only, active-empty-requirements, partially permitted and fully permitted skills. A prompt must never expand the dispatcher allowlist.
chapters.limit: Eligibility and fixture activation checks do not prove live model quality.

chapters.title: Private messaging
chapters.question: A familiar sender does not make a group private
chapters.construct: Implement the owned poll transaction: validate the bounded update batch and lease, admit only allowlisted human private messages with matching sender/chat identity, deduplicate origins, and advance the cursor after durable intake.
chapters.connect: Use the real poll function and SQLite cursor with a fixture bot; reopen the database and replay an unordered batch.
chapters.diagnosis: Checking only the sender allows a group message into a private session.
chapters.hint: Inspect the lease before writes, validate identities by exact integer type, use the existing _enqueue helper, and persist the highest offset after the whole batch.
chapters.transfer: Change account, actor, update order, chat kind and message length. A rejected batch must not partially move the cursor or create work.
chapters.limit: Offline intake proves neither Telegram authentication nor phone delivery.

chapters.title: Scheduling
chapters.question: Missed wakeups should coalesce
chapters.construct: Build the scheduler transaction: validate inputs, honor pause and enabled flags, order due jobs, admit bounded work, retain deferral, advance next_due past now and record skipped intervals.
chapters.connect: Use schedule and tick against SQLite and inspect created work IDs, job time and events across repeated passes.
chapters.diagnosis: Advancing by one interval replays every missed wakeup after downtime.
chapters.hint: Calculate elapsed whole intervals, enqueue one occurrence, then advance by skipped plus one intervals in the same transaction.
chapters.transfer: Use exact due time, fractional intervals, a very long absence and repeated same-time ticks. Separate coalescing from total queue capacity.
chapters.limit: This does not guarantee a running host or a wakeup at an exact wall-clock time.

chapters.title: Exact approval
chapters.question: Small orders can exceed a cumulative ceiling
chapters.construct: Construct approval of one exact digest: validate operator, expiry, current work and proposal state; preserve uncertain outcomes; reserve only a new draft amount; enforce both installed and supplied account ceilings.
chapters.connect: Propose real orders, approve them and inspect retained reservations. Reapproval must not reserve twice and refusal must leave the transaction unchanged.
chapters.diagnosis: Comparing only the next amount ignores money already reserved or spent.
chapters.hint: Keep all authority and accounting checks in db.immediate; compute addition from prior state; compare spent plus reserved plus addition to the smaller ceiling.
chapters.transfer: Test exact-limit acceptance, one-pence overflow, changed digest, stricter policy and repeated approval. Never call a real supplier.
chapters.limit: An approval is bounded authority, not a supplier receipt.

chapters.title: Worker recovery
chapters.question: A surviving process may have lost authority
chapters.construct: Reconstruct the full worker assertion: verify paused state and external authority marker, compare database and claim epochs, match the full running lease identity and enforce delegation deadline and parent cancellation.
chapters.connect: Call observe through the real write path, then replace the epoch while keeping the same database and process.
chapters.diagnosis: A matching worker name and lease generation cannot rescue an old restore epoch.
chapters.hint: Read the control row and marker, reject any mismatch, query the complete claim identity with an unexpired lease, then check research-parent constraints.
chapters.transfer: Keep a fresh claimant writable while refusing stale epoch, expired lease, missing marker and changed role. Count transcript rows after every attempt.
chapters.limit: This local fence cannot recall an external request already admitted before replacement.

chapters.title: Tool isolation
chapters.question: Registration is not permission
chapters.construct: Build dispatch from registry lookup through allowlist, strict arguments, write guard and bounded JSON result. Refuse before invoking an unauthorized handler and keep raw validation inputs out of errors.
chapters.connect: Install the method in the real Dispatcher and observe handler invocation counters, not just returned text.
chapters.diagnosis: A known tool can still be unavailable to this particular worker.
chapters.hint: Check membership before argument validation, require a guard for consequential tools, run it before the handler and enforce encoded output size.
chapters.transfer: Use an unseen tool name, a valid allowed read, a denied registered read, a consequential call and oversized output.
chapters.limit: Dispatcher admission is not OS or network containment; container execution remains a separate chapter experiment.

chapters.title: Evaluation
chapters.question: The oracle must account for reserved stock
chapters.construct: Construct the independent replenishment baseline over a Case: use physical minus reserved stock, include only actual deficits, retain product identity and avoid a model call.
chapters.connect: Feed the same Case through evaluate with OfflineShopModel and compare authored expected quantities to both baseline and real tool observations.
chapters.diagnosis: Ignoring reservations makes the supposedly simpler baseline wrong while the agent can still be right.
chapters.hint: For each stock row compare available stock with threshold; calculate needed from the same quantities; do not read case.expected to produce an answer.
chapters.transfer: Use an empty catalog, exact threshold, renamed products and high reservations. A visible-case lookup and an implementation returning case.expected must fail.
chapters.limit: A passing finite scenario suite is not proof of arbitrary language faithfulness.

chapters.title: Controlled improvement
chapters.question: A test result has a configuration boundary
chapters.construct: Build activation of a staged immutable skill: require named positive cases, detect candidate mutation, compare the active configuration after evaluation and atomically activate the intended version.
chapters.connect: Evaluate outside the write transaction, deliberately activate another skill inside the callback, then inspect the active snapshot.
chapters.diagnosis: A passing callback can describe an obsolete configuration.
chapters.hint: Capture a baseline and serialized candidate before evaluating; require exact True values; compare the snapshot inside db.immediate before swapping active rows.
chapters.transfer: Try missing cases, False and integer one, candidate mutation, explicit stale state and a concurrent activation. Preserve the valid uncontended case.
chapters.limit: Authored callbacks exercise state control; they are not a substitute for live regression evidence.

chapters.title: Bounded delegation
chapters.question: Eleven guests need two tubs
chapters.construct: Build a deterministic catering quote from the catalog and a validated Inquiry. Round portions upward, validate the selling price and return an explicit draft with no stock reservation.
chapters.connect: Invoke the actual quote tool used by the delegated research path and inspect product identity, total and unchanged stock.
chapters.diagnosis: Floor division underquotes any partial tub.
chapters.hint: Read the requested product record, validate positive integer price and use integer ceiling arithmetic for ten portions per tub.
chapters.transfer: Try 1, 10, 17 and 200 guests, a changed product price and invalid Inquiry shapes. Explain why fixed arithmetic earns zero model calls.
chapters.limit: A delegated draft neither reserves stock nor authorizes a purchase.

chapters.title: Operating and restoring
chapters.question: Restore must pause before resuming work
chapters.construct: Construct restore from a separate compatible backup: verify integrity and schema, prepare a fresh epoch, clear old ownership, revoke approvals, pause, publish the authority marker and copy into the same database inode.
chapters.connect: Back up real queued work, restore and attempt a claim through the normal worker API before and after an explicit reconciliation/resume decision.
chapters.diagnosis: Pausing the old database is insufficient if the copied snapshot itself is unpaused.
chapters.hint: Prepare changes in a temporary image; persist and atomically replace the epoch marker; use SQLite backup into the existing connection; leave the result paused.
chapters.transfer: Retain backup hashes, repeat restore, compare authority epochs and test same-path or missing backups. A failed preflight must preserve live work.
chapters.limit: No host reboot or external supplier reconciliation is proved by this local exercise.

chapters.title: Acceptance
chapters.question: A reassuring total can hide missing money
chapters.construct: Construct the operating report from one read snapshot: independently query work, orders, ledger, stock, usage and delivery uncertainty; report disagreement and unknowns; preserve honest scope and bounded detail.
chapters.connect: Create a real approval, corrupt a retained ledger amount, then call the actual report and inspect both structured evidence and displayed exception text.
chapters.diagnosis: Forcing totals to match hides a real accounting discrepancy.
chapters.hint: Read within one transaction and always release it; compare spent and reserved separately with order-state totals; preserve usage completeness and uncertainty in the report.
chapters.transfer: Test an empty account, exact matching reservation, one-pence mismatch, paused operation and incomplete usage history. Treat observed_at as a run observation.
chapters.limit: Local consistency is not an external account audit, daily cash profit or classroom learning evidence.
